note: Adapted from the new-species description in Chhotani (1997); the original is in English; soldier and worker are known and the alate is unknown; the synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers, measurement tables, type records and distribution are omitted; OCR damage in the antennal segment counts and elsewhere has been restored from context.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier anterolateral processes very long and spinose, longer than in other species of the genus; left mandible strongly twisted medially; gula rod-shaped, with a long narrow waist situated below the middle; inner margin of protibia with 12–15 spines.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow, whitish around the fontanelle; antennae pale brown; body and legs creamy white; left mandible black, right mandible dark red. Head sparsely hairy, body more densely so. Body length 6.30–7.00 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly straight or slightly convex, length 1.622–1.771 times the width; in lateral view the frons slopes forward about 45°, the posterior part of the head straight; anterolateral processes very long and spinose, longer than in other species of the genus; coronal suture reaching slightly beyond the middle of the head. Fontanelle transverse, sclerotized, situated on the anterior part of the frontal slope, about 5/6 of the head length from the posterior margin. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 subequal, segment 2 or 4 sometimes shorter. Labrum asymmetrical, anterior margin broad and deeply concave; lateral margins prolonged into long slender spine-like processes, anterolateral margins with several small teeth at the base of the spine. Mandibles asymmetrical, shorter than the head length, ratio of mandible length to head length 0.820–0.857. Left mandible strongly twisted medially, with a minute apical impression at the tip; right mandible blade-like, apex short, inner margin weakly incurved, tip short and pointed. Gula rod-shaped; waist long and narrow, situated below the middle. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin notched. Inner margin of protibia with 12–15 spines.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule and postclypeus pale yellow; antennae, thorax and legs creamy white. Head moderately hairy, body more densely so. Body length 4.6–5.4 mm. Head subcircular, broader than long; head length to tip of labrum 1.3–1.4 mm, head length to mandibular base 0.9–1.0 mm, maximum head width 1.08–1.15 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 3 and 4 subequal, segment 2 slightly longer. Postclypeus strongly convex, about half as long as wide; length 0.25–0.28 mm, width 0.53–0.57 mm. Labrum dome-shaped, length 0.30–0.38 mm, width 0.45–0.48 mm. Mandibles, thorax and legs as in the genus. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, length 0.25–0.33 mm, width 0.57–0.60 mm.
